definitions.explanation: A profound emotional impact left by something admirable or meaningful. Stronger and more formal than simply being impressed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{感銘|かんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{聴衆|ちょうしゅう}→聴衆：13907_choushuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{感銘|かんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The speech made a deep impression on the audience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{感銘|かんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|あゆ}もう→歩む：13196_ayumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I was so deeply moved by the way he lives that I decided to follow the same path.

notes:
WRITING:
⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling/emotion) + ⟦{銘|めい}→銘：24393_mei⟧ (inscription/engraving). The image is of an impression being "engraved" on the heart.

USAGE:
Almost always appears in the set phrases {感銘|かんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to be deeply impressed) or {感銘|かんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧ (to make a deep impression on someone). A relatively formal word commonly used in speeches, essays, and interviews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感銘|かんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be deeply impressed
- {感銘|かんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to make a deep impression
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{感銘|かんめい}: a deep impression
- {感銘|かんめい}{深|ぶか}い: deeply impressive
